newsitem.title: FRANCE: French stocks down over one pct in cautious trade.
newsitem.headline: French stocks down over one pct in cautious trade.

text.p: French stocks were down more than one percent in early trading on Wednesday on investor caution ahead of Sunday's parliamentary election runoff, brokers said.

The CAC-40 index was down 31.55 points, or 1.18 percent, at 2,648.79 after sliding back from a slightly higher opening. The CAC-40 May futures contract was down 28 at 2,650 -- levels at which some brokers expect the market to consolidate defensively.
Volume was one billion francs in the first 40 minutes.
